# Southshore Projects

> Southshore Projects Limited is a UK design and construction practice offering architecture, structural engineering, structural integrity and defect reports, interior design, construction, design and build, commercial fit-out and project management. Head office in Wimbledon, London, with offices in Northampton, Oxford, Brighton and Reading.

- [Home](https://southshoreprojects.com/): Overview of the practice and its services
- [About](https://southshoreprojects.com/about): Who we are and how we work
- [Services](https://southshoreprojects.com/services): Architecture, structural engineering, defect reports, construction and more, plus the areas we cover
- [Projects](https://southshoreprojects.com/projects): Architectural, structural and construction projects
- [Gallery](https://southshoreprojects.com/gallery): Photos from Southshore sites
- [Contact](https://southshoreprojects.com/contact): Phone, email, office addresses and enquiry form
